preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() or c.isspace() or c in '()' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string must only contain letters, spaces, and parentheses.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join(c for c in s if c not in '()')
postconditions.description: The output must be the input string with all parentheses and their contents removed.
